title: Independent static review of three prepared native-0af8 schema contracts

conclusion.decision: No static blocker found in the three negative-case definitions and their specified rejection paths. Actual contract execution remains pending.

scope.reader_scope: Hash identity and Evidence.read primitive only, to inspect the test file-read preconditions. The complete adapter/runner/original-input review belongs to Core.
scope.only_output_written: This independent reviewer JSON, outside the prepared package and its planned output directory.

common_setup_and_control: Hash-checked module loading, explicit fixture-root resolution and every fixture read occur outside all assertRaisesRegex blocks. Missing files, hash mismatch or setup errors cannot be accepted as a negative-case success.
Every test calls the same validator first with the original correct input before constructing the negative mutation. A failed positive control is an ordinary test error, not an expected rejection.

Each expected-error context contains exactly one validator call and requires ValueError with the case-specific message. The baseline calls, next() lookups, display-count assertion and mutation operations are outside those contexts.
The entry point fixes the three named methods and returns success only when unittest.wasSuccessful() is true. A missing evidence-root argument or setUpClass failure cannot produce a successful suite.

cases.name: test_verbose_test_execution_cannot_borrow_another_artifact
cases.baseline: Pinned original verbose Rust log plus pinned locked metadata are accepted by validate_rust_log before mutation; the test then requires exactly one display for the root zcalld artifact.
cases.mutation: Keep raw compiler artifacts and the root parent environment; replace the selected root display executable with the known zcalld_compat_client test executable.
cases.static_branch_path: The original successful control establishes the ordered root parent. In its first iteration, the alternative executable is a known unused artifact, so the unique-artifact guard is satisfied. Its package is zcalld-compat-client while the expected first package is zcalld, reaching the named package/source/profile rejection before the later execution-environment or test-count guards.
cases.scope_boundary: This definition catches borrowing another valid artifact; it is not an executed result and does not replace Core original-fixture validation.

cases.name: test_manifest_byte_claim_must_match_the_same_blob_read
cases.baseline: The test writes one private regular nonexecutable file containing body\n (five bytes), computes its correct Git blob and SHA-256, and validates the correct declaration first.
cases.mutation: Only the declared byte count changes 5 to 6; the same file, SHA-256 and Git object remain. Each call receives a fresh Evidence object.
cases.static_branch_path: The unchanged file passes root/path/type/mode/stability/Git-blob checks. The bytes declaration then disagrees with len(data) from that same verified read, triggering the required byte-declaration error. File setup and the successful-control call are outside the expected-error context.
cases.required_rejection: source byte declaration differs from the same verified Git-blob read
cases.scope_boundary: Only a private TemporaryDirectory synthetic input would be created during the authorized future contract execution; this reviewer created none.

cases.name: test_complete_job_snapshot_cannot_cover_truncated_stream_bytes
cases.baseline: The fixed original start/completion/handoff/gate/scope and hash-bound job882 readback are first accepted together.
cases.mutation: Keep original completed snapshot and EOF claims; shorten stdout, and update only its base64 encoding and cursor to the shortened stream.
cases.static_branch_path: Earlier command/identity/snapshot checks see the same accepted records. The stdout branch requires the original fixed 2000-byte stream and cursor before JSON gate-projection parsing; the shortened text/cursor fails the specified completeness condition despite the successful snapshot and EOF claims.
cases.scope_boundary: The prepared case is a raw-stream completeness contract, not a new job882/product execution.

run_plan_alignment.constraints_preserved: The plan still requires static approval and an authorized copy/readback before one-location execution; all three successful controls and exact rejection expectations remain. It does not grant execution by itself.

not_established: The three contracts have passed at runtime
The complete new adapter/runner is admissible; Core is reviewing that separately
